purpose: The agreed back-up plan (planning/archive/SAC_RECOVERY_PLAN.md section 0), run to see whether a focused stage 8 improves on the 3 M policy. Restarts from the 2.5 M checkpoint of baseline-v3 SAC seed 0 and trains to 3.0 M (the 3 M limit): three-panel layouts in 70 % of episodes, weighted to the failing cases, failure replay, and an exploration boost. Reward and observation unchanged. The 3 M policy is kept as the best policy (runs/sac_formulation_seed0_bl3/kept_best_3M/).
field_weights_basis: failure rates of the 3 M policy: three-panel development set (NT 0.30, HO 0.35, CRP 0.31-0.38, CRS 0.35, OT 0.04-0.08, BO 0.19) and the Paper 2 set's fixed-speed cases (HO 0.35, CRP 0.43, CRS 0.45, OT 0.25, BO 0.35); no-target kept at a quarter of field episodes because passing every no-target layout is a hard requirement
stage_definition_note: stage 7 otherwise unchanged: no CPA guard, 30 % of field targets varying speed, 30 % near-reference layouts, space-time solvability, clutter 1-3 weighted to 3
selection: goal - 2 x collision over the development set (120) plus the v3 three-panel development set (150), supervisor off; the 2.5 M start model is evaluated first
test: the frozen suite and the Paper 2 set on this run's best model, compared with the 3 M policy (sacs0_bl3)
